_about: GHOST J (Jesko): an untextured cabin; its screen on the steering wheel (turning with it: on_wheel) and its centre screen are blank faces of the interior's material, so each gets a board laid on it, measured from its faces (rays from the driver's eye; m from the steering wheel's centre, the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): a digital cluster and the centre screen's pages in its red. Ambient lighting: red, as its trim. A piece of its steering wheel's rim, left in the body by the model's cut, is moved onto the wheel (wheel_parts).
